destinations.history: It honors the squadron that flew P-47s in the Philippines in 1945, names five pilots who died in combat, and shows a T-28 Trojan used on Cozumel from 1961 to 1980.

destinations.access: On Avenida Rafael E. Melgar, outside the entrance to Military Air Base No. 4. Viewable from the public street; do not enter the base.
destinations.safety: Beside a road and a military gate: stay on the sidewalk with a parent or guardian.
